parsed.answer: The claim is contradicted by the retrieved evidence. In 45 patients with non-toxic multinodular goitre treated with a single dose of 131I, median thyroid volume fell from 73 ml (IQR 50-106) to 29 ml (IQR 23-48) at 24 months, a median reduction of 40 ml (60%, p < 0.0001), with half the reduction occurring within three months. Patients receiving two doses and those developing hypo- or hyperthyroidism also showed significant volume reduction, so radioiodine decreases rather than increases thyroid volume.
